pages.text: This page grows as you do. Whatever you have reached, the next step is written at the end.$(br2)$(l)Now:$() find $(l)Glimmerstone$() between the surface and the deepslate, mine a $(item)Dull Shard$(), and stand under open sky in a $(l)thunderstorm$() with it in hand.
pages.title: Your Path

pages.text: $(l)You are Awakened.$()$(br2)Build a $(l)Research Table$() and study there: four Dull Shards and 50 mana each time. Your first study makes you an $(l)Apprentice$().$(br2)Hold G to open the spell wheel.
pages.title: Next: Apprentice

pages.text: $(l)You are an Apprentice.$()$(br2)Build a $(l)Ritual Altar$(). The Rituals of $(l)Insight$() and $(l)Deepening$() help you gather Knowledge and mana.$(br2)When you have 10 Knowledge, offer an $(item)Amethyst Shard$() in the $(l)Ritual of the Threshold$() to enter the Arcane Arts.
pages.title: Next: The Arcane Arts

pages.text: $(l)You practise the Arcane Arts.$()$(br2)Open a school of magic in your Spellbook.$(br2)Then make your first artifact: offer a $(item)Blaze Rod$() at the altar to infuse a $(l)Focus Wand$(). Making anything by infusion proves your $(l)Mastery$().
pages.title: Next: Mastery

pages.text: $(l)You have Mastery.$()$(br2)Grow to $(l)200 maximum mana$() and $(l)20 Knowledge$(), then offer an $(item)Echo Shard$() in the $(l)Ritual of Ascension$().$(br2)Meanwhile: batteries, conduits and the Infuser let your machines work while you don't.
pages.title: Next: Ascension

pages.text: $(l)You have Ascended.$()$(br2)The $(l)Forbidden$() school is open, and $(l)Veil Step$() can carry you into $(l)the Hollow$().$(br2)Hunt its creatures for their materials (see the $(l)Hollow Bestiary$()) and infuse $(l)Hollow Charms$() from them.
pages.title: Beyond
Next: Archmage
pages.text: The last step: craft the $(l)Seal of Unmaking$(), then perform the $(l)Ritual of Unmaking$() in the Hollow itself.$(br2)What answers is the source of the Hollow. $(l)Silence the Listener$() and you become $(l)Archmage$(): +100 maximum mana, your corruption washed away, and every spell able to reach $(l)tier IV$().

pages.title: Archmage
pages.text: $(l)You are Archmage.$() There is no stage beyond this one.$(br2)What is left is mastery: tier IV for every spell, wands grown to $(l)Mythic$(), every charm, every upgraded garment, and the quiet places of the Hollow still unexplored.
